subject: VM posture snapshot: requested evidence, remediation timeline and audit notes
messages:
From: Evan Porter <security@atlasops.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM posture snapshot + temporary SLA exception for 3rd-party bundle

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. As part of our SIG and internal audit window we need a concise snapshot of Redwood's vulnerability management posture for the services we rely on (the AtlasOps connector). Specifically we need: 

- Recent scan cadence (past 90 days) and a machine-readable index of findings
- Your remediation SLA commitments for CVE classes (critical / high / medium / low)
- Any temporary SLA exceptions or backstop processes you applied to third-party bundles used in our connector (we flagged a transitive dependency that triggered a medium CVE)
- Evidence we can attach to our SIG questionnaire (scan exports, remediation plan, and a short attestation)

Deadline: Leah from our compliance team is collecting docs next Wednesday (2028-08-16). Can you confirm you can deliver a packet and a short attestation? If you have a preferred contact for the technical remediation notes, please include them.

Thanks,
Evan Porter
Security Lead, AtlasOps
[Attachment: atlas-sig-questionnaire-v2.docx]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Porter <security@atlasops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM posture snapshot + temporary SLA exception for 3rd-party bundle

Evan — thanks for the clear list. We'll put together a compact packet and an attestation for Leah. Quick plan: 

1) Deliverables by EOD Monday (2028-08-13): scan export (CSV), remediation summary, and a short attestation letter.
2) Follow-up deep-dive (if needed) on Wednesday 08/16 with your compliance team.

Marissa, Jordan — looping you in to own artifacts and the remediation note. Marissa, can you capture the scan-index and the triage timeline; Jordan, please include the temporary exception log and the patch backlog for the third-party bundle Evan mentioned.

Evan — we'll attach: scan-index-2028Q3.csv and cve-closure-plan-AtlasOps.pdf. If that's sufficient for Leah, we'll call that closed; otherwise we'll schedule the deep-dive on 08/16.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Porter <security@atlasops.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Aug 2028 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM posture snapshot + temporary SLA exception for 3rd-party bundle

Soojin / Jordan / Evan — attaching the artifacts we agreed. See the short notes below and the changelog file.

[Attachment: scan-index-2028Q3.csv]
[Attachment: cve-closure-plan-AtlasOps.pdf]
[Attachment: remediation-changelog-20280812.txt]

Snapshot highlights (past 90 days):
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated scans on Monday (hosted infra) + monthly dependency SBOM scans for connectors. Full index provided.
- Triage SLA: findings triaged within 48 hours; initial owner assignment within 24 hours for critical/high.
- Remediation SLA: critical CVEs: 30 days (hotfix/backport); high: 60 days; medium: 90 days; low: next maintenance window.
- Temporary exception: one transitive medium (pkg:thirdparty/connector-utils v2.3.1) was held under exception for 7 days while vendor patch landed; compensating control: WAF rule and additional runtime mitigation applied (see remediation-changelog).

Remediation plan summary (for AtlasOps connector):
- Critical: none open in last 90 days.
- High: 1 open, PR#4517 queued, targeted patch 2028-08-18.
- Medium: 2 open, planned backport and upgrade 2028-08-25.

Attestation (short): "Redwood Inference confirms regular vulnerability scanning and a documented SLA-backed remediation program. For customer-specific connector integrations, we maintain a documented exception and compensating-control process; details provided in attached packet."

Jordan (cc) maintains the exception log and will provide the audit link.

—
Marissa Cole
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Evan Porter <security@atlasops.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Leah Kim <compliance@veridiansolutions.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Aug 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM posture snapshot + temporary SLA exception for 3rd-party bundle

Soojin / Marissa — received, thank you. Packet looks good for our SIG intake. Leah, we should be able to attach the scan CSV and the attestation to the questionnaire. A couple of small asks before we close: 

- Can you include the PR# links (Marissa referenced PR#4517) in the changelog file or provide a one-line mapping to the public tracker?
- We will take the deep-dive on 08/16 only if our audits need it; otherwise this packet will suffice.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — please send the audit folder link when ready (Jordan).

Thanks,
Evan
Security Lead, AtlasOps
